A bounded, data-only condition; arbitrary Python expressions are not accepted.

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明与约束 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `all` | array&lt;[WorkflowCondition](schemas.md#schema-WorkflowCondition)&gt; anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{"items": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"}, "maxItems": 16, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}]` |
| `any` | array&lt;[WorkflowCondition](schemas.md#schema-WorkflowCondition)&gt; anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{"items": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"}, "maxItems": 16, "type": "array"}, {"type": "null"}]` |
| `not` | [WorkflowCondition](schemas.md#schema-WorkflowCondition) anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{"$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"}, {"type": "null"}]` |
| `path` | string anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{"maxLength": 240, "pattern": "^(task\\.(input&#124;generic_state&#124;domain_state&#124;final_output)(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*&#124;steps\\.[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\\.(status&#124;result_summary&#124;output)(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*)$", "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}]` |
| `operator` | string anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{"enum": ["equals", "not_equals", "contains", "not_contains", "exists", "not_exists", "in", "not_in", "greater_than", "greater_than_or_equal", "less_than", "less_than_or_equal"], "type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}]` |
| `value` | any anyOf null | 否 | `anyOf=[{}, {"type": "null"}]` |

  "properties": {
    "all": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"
          },
          "maxItems": 16,
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "All"
    },
    "any": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "items": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"
          },
          "maxItems": 16,
          "type": "array"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Any"
    },
    "not": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/WorkflowCondition"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ]
    },
    "operator": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "enum": [
            "equals",
            "not_equals",
            "contains",
            "not_contains",
            "exists",
            "not_exists",
            "in",
            "not_in",
            "greater_than",
            "greater_than_or_equal",
            "less_than",
            "less_than_or_equal"
          ],
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Operator"
    },
    "path": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "maxLength": 240,
          "pattern": "^(task\\.(input|generic_state|domain_state|final_output)(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*|steps\\.[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\\.(status|result_summary|output)(\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*)$",
          "type": "string"
        },
        {
          "type": "null"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Path"
    },
    "value": {

        {},
        {
          "type": "null"

| 字段 | 类型 | 必填 | 说明与约束 |

| `monthly_limit` | number anyOf string | 是 | `anyOf=[{"exclusiveMinimum": 0.0, "type": "number"}, {"pattern": "^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*\\d*\\.?\\d*$", "type": "string"}]` |
| `warning_ratio` | number anyOf string | 否 | `anyOf=[{"exclusiveMinimum": 0.0, "maximum": 1.0, "type": "number"}, {"pattern": "^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*\\d*\\.?\\d*$", "type": "string"}]`; `default="0.8"` |
| `enforcement` | string | 否 | `default="warn"`; `pattern="^(warn&#124;block)$"` |
| `enabled` | boolean | 否 | `default=true` |

```json
{
  "properties": {
    "currency": {
      "default": "USD",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z]{3}$",
      "title": "Currency",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "enabled": {
      "default": true,
      "title": "Enabled",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "enforcement": {
      "default": "warn",
      "pattern": "^(warn|block)$",
      "title": "Enforcement",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "monthly_limit": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0.0,
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "pattern": "^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*\\d*\\.?\\d*$",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "title": "Monthly Limit"
    },
    "warning_ratio": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "exclusiveMinimum": 0.0,
          "maximum": 1.0,
          "type": "number"
        },
        {
          "pattern": "^(?!^[-+.]*$)[+-]?0*\\d*\\.?\\d*$",
          "type": "string"
        }
      ],
      "default": "0.8",
      "title": "Warning Ratio"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "monthly_limit"
  ],
  "title": "WorkspaceCostBudgetRequest",
  "type": "object"
}
```
